tagline.sw: Kwa wasanidi programu wanaotaka kujenga kwa Bitcoin, Lightning na Fedimint, na kuchangia Bitsacco.
tagline.en: For developers who want to build on Bitcoin, Lightning and Fedimint, and contribute to Bitsacco.

description.sw: Kutoka maabara yako ya regtest hadi miamala, funguo, Lightning na Fedimint, kisha jenga programu ndogo na uchangie programu huria. Unahitaji kujua kutumia terminal na lugha moja ya programu.
description.en: From your own regtest lab to transactions, keys, Lightning and Fedimint, then build a mini-app and contribute to open source. You should be comfortable with a terminal and one programming language.
